verdict.rationale: The IRS has machine channels (MeF system-to-system XML transmission and IRIS A2A intake), so event subscription is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The probes found no OpenAPI or developer API surface, and the A2A channels are inbound submission rails, not event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
